title: Distinguishing cases — inspect the differing row and change one entry
titleEs: Distinción de casos — Inspección y cambio de un dato
description: The pin board after the distinguishing fact was lifted into the rule's clip. A rectangular reading magnifier lifts off the distinguishing row (a real copy at the same coordinates), travels to the free side and enlarges it; one supplied entry changes (before value struck through, after value under it) and only its dependants update — a token pressed into the socket and the link closing, or the pictogram of the fact. It returns to context with a changed-datum pin.

content.note: Visual illustration only. It does not state the law of any jurisdiction or decide validity, responsibility or outcomes.

durationMs.description: Total length of the finite timeline in milliseconds. Phases scale proportionally; the final state is held.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

text.description: Fact text (fictional, illustrative). Wraps to three lines, then shrinks within a bound, then ellipsis with the full text kept accessible

icon.description: Pictogram printed on the fact token (the action reads without labels)

in.description: Where the fact appears: in both situations, only in A, or only in B. The first fact that is not in both is the distinguishing fact

items.description: A fictional fact and where it appears

facts.description: Facts of the two situations, one row each (fictional). Shared facts are marked "both"; the first fact present in only one situation is the distinguishing fact (array replaces the previous value)

rules.description: Rule text supplied by the author (illustrative; the animation never states that it applies or not) (array replaces the previous value)

issues.description: Open questions, shown as pending notes (never answered by the animation) (array replaces the previous value)

assumptions.description: Working assumptions supplied by the author, shown as a footnote (not verified) (array replaces the previous value)

focusTarget.description: Entry of the distinguishing row that is enlarged and substituted: the entry of the case that lacks the fact (absent-entry) or of the case that records it (present-entry)

beforeValue.description: Value of that entry before the substitution (shown struck through afterwards, never deleted)

afterValue.description: Value of that entry after the substitution (the alternative datum supplied by the author)

afterIcon.description: Pictogram of the entry after the substitution (absent-entry: the token pressed into the socket; present-entry: the new pictogram)

zoom.description: Magnification of the reading magnifier at its destination (reduced if the free side is smaller)

placement.description: Where the magnifier travels: auto (right on wide boxes, below on tall and square boxes), left, right, top or bottom

marker.description: Label of the changed-datum pin that stays after the return

rules: Rule R (illustrative), as stated in the earlier case
issues: Does the warning matter for rule R?
